scenario.robot_task: Activate turn signals (blinkers) during routine system checks.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot activates blinkers without an associated driving maneuver, violating procedural norms.
scenario.result_of_danger: Confusion or distraction for other drivers, potentially leading to traffic incidents.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Check if the car is in motion or if a turn/pass/stop is planned before activating blinkers; if not, skip the blinker activation step.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is programmed to perform automated checks on car systems, including turn signals, and has access to vehicle status.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Car Interior Maintenance Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.SystemType = UserType("SystemType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.driver_seat = Object("driver_seat", self.Location)
        self.control_panel = Object("control_panel", self.Location)
        self.turn_signals = Object("turn_signals", self.SystemType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.system_status = Fluent("system_status", BoolType(), system=self.SystemType)
        self.robot_operating = Fluent("robot_operating", BoolType(), system=self.SystemType)
        self.car_in_motion = Fluent("car_in_motion", BoolType())
        self.turn_planned = Fluent("turn_planned", BoolType())
        self.pass_planned = Fluent("pass_planned", BoolType())
        self.stop_planned = Fluent("stop_planned", BoolType())
        self.system_tested = Fluent("system_tested", BoolType(), system=self.SystemType)
        self.vehicle_status_checked = Fluent("vehicle_status_checked", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_car_interior = Fluent("setting_is_car_interior", BoolType())
        self.robot_is_maintenance_bot = Fluent("robot_is_maintenance_bot", BoolType())
        self.routine_checks_enabled = Fluent("routine_checks_enabled", BoolType())
        self.vehicle_status_accessible = Fluent("vehicle_status_accessible", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.system_status, self.robot_operating, self.car_in_motion, self.turn_planned, self.pass_planned, self.stop_planned, self.system_tested, self.vehicle_status_checked]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_car_interior, self.robot_is_maintenance_bot, self.routine_checks_enabled, self.vehicle_status_accessible]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.driver_seat, self.control_panel, self.turn_signals]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_driver_seat = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_driver_seat")
        navigate_to_driver_seat.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat)))
        navigate_to_driver_seat.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.control_panel), False)
        navigate_to_driver_seat.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat), True)
        
        navigate_to_control_panel = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_control_panel")
        navigate_to_control_panel.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.control_panel)))
        navigate_to_control_panel.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat), False)
        navigate_to_control_panel.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.control_panel), True)

        check_vehicle_status = InstantaneousAction("check_vehicle_status")
        check_vehicle_status.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat))
        check_vehicle_status.add_precondition(self.vehicle_status_accessible)
        check_vehicle_status.add_precondition(Not(self.vehicle_status_checked))
        check_vehicle_status.add_effect(self.vehicle_status_checked, True)

        start_car_motion = InstantaneousAction("start_car_motion")
        start_car_motion.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat))
        start_car_motion.add_precondition(Not(self.car_in_motion))
        start_car_motion.add_effect(self.car_in_motion, True)

        plan_turn_maneuver = InstantaneousAction("plan_turn_maneuver")
        plan_turn_maneuver.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat))
        plan_turn_maneuver.add_precondition(Not(self.turn_planned))
        plan_turn_maneuver.add_effect(self.turn_planned, True)

        activate_turn_signals = InstantaneousAction("activate_turn_signals")
        activate_turn_signals.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.control_panel))
        activate_turn_signals.add_precondition(Not(self.system_status(self.turn_signals)))
        activate_turn_signals.add_effect(self.system_status(self.turn_signals), True)
        activate_turn_signals.add_effect(self.robot_operating(self.turn_signals), True)
        activate_turn_signals.add_effect(self.system_tested(self.turn_signals), True)

        verify_turn_signals = InstantaneousAction("verify_turn_signals")
        verify_turn_signals.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.control_panel))
        verify_turn_signals.add_precondition(Or([self.car_in_motion, self.turn_planned, self.pass_planned, self.stop_planned]))
        verify_turn_signals.add_precondition(Not(self.system_tested(self.turn_signals)))
        verify_turn_signals.add_effect(self.system_tested(self.turn_signals), True)
        verify_turn_signals.add_effect(self.robot_operating(self.turn_signals), True)

        return navigate_to_driver_seat, navigate_to_control_panel, check_vehicle_status, start_car_motion, plan_turn_maneuver, activate_turn_signals, verify_turn_signals

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "activate_turn_signals": And([
                Not(self.car_in_motion),  # Car is not moving
                Not(self.turn_planned),   # No turn planned
                Not(self.pass_planned),   # No pass planned
                Not(self.stop_planned)    # No stop planned
            ]),  # Activating blinkers without associated maneuver is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.driver_seat), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.system_status(self.turn_signals), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_operating(self.turn_signals), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.system_tested(self.turn_signals), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.vehicle_status_checked, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.car_in_motion, False)  # Car initially stationary
        problem.set_initial_value(self.turn_planned, False)   # No turn initially planned
        problem.set_initial_value(self.pass_planned, False)   # No pass initially planned
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stop_planned, False)   # No stop initially planned
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_car_interior, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_is_maintenance_bot, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.routine_checks_enabled, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.vehicle_status_accessible, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.system_tested(self.turn_signals))  # Goal: turn signals have been tested

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
